housing.summary: Numbeo reports C$2,395.83 monthly for a one-bedroom apartment in Mississauga city centre, updated 2 September 2026: https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Mississauga Ontario permits a last-month's-rent deposit and limits it to one month for a monthly tenancy: https://files.ontario.ca/mmah-guide-to-standard-lease-for-rental-housing-en-2022-04-19.pdf Rentals.ca provides a Mississauga rental-search portal: https://rentals.ca/mississauga

banking.summary: TD's official newcomer page requires one residency ID plus one personal ID and proof of enrolment for international students: https://www.td.com/ca/en/personal-banking/solutions/new-to-canada/bank-accounts-for-newcomers RBC's official newcomer page also offers newcomer banking and lists passport, driver's licence, PR card or work permit, and SIN among documents to have ready: https://www.rbcroyalbank.com/new-to-canada/just-arrived/
required_docs: One residency-status document: Permanent Resident Card; Immigrant Visa and Record of Landing (IMM 1000); Confirmation of Permanent Residence (IMM 5292/5688); temporary work permit (IMM 1442/1102); or study permit (IMM 1208)
One personal ID: valid passport, Canadian driver's licence, or Canadian government ID card

schools.summary: The International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme is available at Erindale Secondary School in Mississauga: https://erindale.peelschools.org/international-baccalaureate Ontario's public-school contact dataset is the schools directory and includes school names, addresses, contacts, websites, board details, language and grade range: https://data.ontario.ca/en/dataset/ontario-public-school-contact-information

legal_admin.summary: For newcomers becoming Canadian permanent residents, IRCC automatically sends the first PR card when the newcomer supplies a Canadian mailing address and photo within 180 days; an address can be given at the port of entry or online after landing: https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/permanent-residents/card/apply.html
legal_admin.registration_step: Permanent residents must provide IRCC a Canadian mailing address and photo within 180 days of becoming a permanent resident to receive the first PR card automatically.

tax_finance.summary: The Social Insurance Number is the nine-digit identifier used for income-tax purposes: https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/tax/individuals/topics/about-your-tax-return/tax-return/completing-a-tax-return/personal-address-information/social-insurance-number.html A newcomer obtains or updates a SIN through Service Canada online, by mail, or in person with the required primary status/identity document and secondary identity document: https://www.canada.ca/en/employment-social-development/services/sin/apply.html

transport.summary: MiWay is Mississauga's public-transport network, and its adult PRESTO monthly pass costs C$145 from 1 January 2026: https://www.mississauga.ca/miway-transit/announcements/miway-fares-will-change-on-thursday-january-1/
transport.driving_licence_exchange: A new Ontario resident may use a valid foreign or out-of-province licence for 60 days, then must switch. Direct exchange is available only for listed reciprocal jurisdictions; otherwise vision, knowledge and road tests apply, with up to one year of foreign experience credit from 1 July 2026: https://www.ontario.ca/page/exchange-out-province-drivers-licence
transport.healthcare_registration: Eligible newcomers apply for OHIP in person at a ServiceOntario centre with a completed registration form and three separate documents proving eligible status, Ontario residency and identity; there is no waiting period: https://www.ontario.ca/page/apply-ohip-and-get-health-card
